title: Delhi HC: Unregistered GPA Sale Of JJR Scheme Flat Gives No Title
seo_title: Delhi HC: GPA Sale Of JJR Flat Gives No Title
card_summary: The Delhi High Court dismissed an appeal by a man claiming rights over a Jhuggi Jhopri Removal Scheme flat through an unregistered general power of attorney, agreement to sell and will. Justice Rajneesh Kumar Gupta held these unregistered documents convey no valid title over a public housing allotment, and a co-sharer in the original allotment can sue an unauthorised occupant for possession.
card_tip: Buyers of DDA, DUSIB or similar public housing allotments should check whether the scheme itself permits resale, since a GPA or agreement to sell alone will not transfer title.
